---
name: link-audit
description: Audit Ventura OpenSource upstream and learning links for canonical destinations duplicates and stale references. Use when maintaining or releasing the open programming material index. Do not use when reviewing upstream license compatibility or source-code quality.
---

# Link audit

- Check links in changed resource sections.
- Prefer canonical upstream repositories documentation and publisher pages.
- Detect forks mirrors and duplicates when the canonical source is available.
- Flag dead moved archived or clearly obsolete references.
- Preserve archived projects only when their status is explicit.
- Recheck Markdown formatting after edits.
